# SiteLift — WordPress-exit website migrations (Toledo Technologies)

SiteLift is a productized route off WordPress with explicit controls for content, redirects,
forms, access, and account ownership. It targets a faster, lower-maintenance stack without
promising a ranking or cost outcome before the current site is assessed. By Toledo Technologies,
a Connecticut web studio run by Nicholas Toledo and available for United States engagements.

Contact: hello@toledotechnologies.com · https://sitelift.toledotechnologies.com

## What it is
- A productized WordPress-exit migration quoted after a $750 Delphi Fit Check.
- Published bands: Arcadia $3,500–$5,500 (simple 3–7 page sites), Aegis $7,500–$12,500 (standard small-business
  migration; default quote about $9,500), Odyssey $15,000–$30,000, Elysian $30,000–$65,000+. Final scope follows the Fit Check.
- SEO-sensitive elements are inventoried and redirects are mapped; the default hosting target is $20/mo before overages and third-party services; client accounts stay under client control.

## Good fit
Small businesses tired of WordPress updates, plugin bloat, security scares, and slow hosting —
who want a fast, accessible site and a developer who ships instead of sending status updates.
